ov: The only bear native to South America, living in the Andes, and the last of the short-faced bears. It is named for the pale markings on its face and chest, which can look like spectacles. It eats more plants than most bears; only about 5–7% of its diet is meat.

why.dg: Only one human death has ever been reported, and that bear was being hunted and had already been shot.

rg: The Andes of northern and western South America.
df: Mostly plants such as cactus and bromeliads, crops such as sugarcane and maize, some honey and a little meat.
fx: The children’s character Paddington Bear is a spectacled bear from Peru.
A captive spectacled bear in Maryland lived to 37 years and 11 months.
